verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.perplexity.ai/llms.txt that describes the API documentation. Every docs page is also served as markdown (.md) with a header pointing agents to the llms.txt index, and a machine-readable openapi.json is published. Many docs citations reference these .md URLs, which corroborates agent-oriented doc delivery. missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, no evidence of an llms-full.txt variant.
